title: Artemis II Crew Observes 5 Meteor Impacts on Lunar Surface — First Direct Human Sighting
detail: Artemis II crew members reported seeing the bright flashes of 5 separate meteor impacts on the lunar surface during their mission — a rare direct human observation of ongoing lunar bombardment, marking the first time humans have witnessed lunar impact events in real time.

title: Artemis II Crew Describes Unexpected Yellow and Green Color Hues Across Moon's Surface
detail: Artemis II crew members described seeing unexpected yellow and green color hues across the Moon's surface during the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years, providing new perceptual data that may inform future lunar science and human visual experience studies.
